_comment: Generated by tools/extract/extract_gate_sounds.py rows (docs/progress/gate-sounds.md): the sounds Arena plays on the gates the port moves. rows = one per gate unit of tools/maps/<stem>.doors.json that Arena gives a sound. A row belongs to a gate part when barrier is equal, part is null or equal ('' = the barrier root itself moves), at is null or within 0.05 m of the part's barrier instance (world position, as in the door rows), closed_position is null or within 0.05 m of the part's closed local position (AirPit's passport leaves: six names for sixteen leaves). emitter = the WORLD position the sound plays from (Arena's player object). clip names an entry of clips (an AudioClip of the map's shared assets). source_volume is the AudioSource's volume, player_volume the EntitySoundPlayer's; the client plays at source_volume * player_volume * 10^(mixer_db / 20) * Spawns/GateSoundVolume. mixer = the mixer group the PLAYER names (ArenaGates, -15 dB, or null = none, 0 dB), source_mixer = the group of the AudioSource itself (Environment on Bay5's gates and AirPit's bus doors: which one wins in Arena is not known, the player's is baked). authored_pitch is what Arena plays the clip at; pitch is what the CLIENT still applies: 1 for every clip, AirPit's two clips are resampled by their pitch when they are extracted (tools/extract/gate_sound_fit.json bake_pitch). min_distance / max_distance are the player's. A borrowed row (origin 'borrowed ...') is for a gate Arena authors no player for and copies its lender's. skipped = players of Arena that no gate of the port is near (other modes) or that duplicate a kept row. Object names and derived numbers only; no Arena asset or file is stored.
